Parts.Description: A parking lot with white lines, a blue badge plaza and a sidewalk along the road.
Parts.Name: Asphalt and Plaza

Parts.Description: A big white and blue station with two wings, a clock tower and a flag. Police Shiba guards the courtyard.
Parts.Name: Police Headquarters

Parts.Description: Three white patrol cars with light bars, parked nose out in the lot.
Parts.Name: Patrol Cars

Parts.Description: A grey cell block with barred windows, a fenced yard and a guard tower.
Parts.Name: Holding Cells

Parts.Description: A pink donut shop with a giant donut on the roof. Every cop's favourite stop.
Parts.Name: Donut Shop

Parts.Description: A tall steel tower with a red and blue siren on top that you can see from the whole plot.
Parts.Name: Siren Tower

Parts.Description: Four target lanes with a wooden bench and a dirt wall. Bonk practice, of course.
Parts.Name: Shooting Range

Parts.Description: Three doghouses in a fenced run for the police dogs, with food bowls and a big K-9 sign.
Parts.Name: K-9 Kennel

Parts.Description: The showpiece: a blue police helicopter waiting on its helipad.
Parts.Name: Police Helicopter

Parts.Description: Red and white barriers, orange cones, a stop sign and a spike strip across the road.
Parts.Name: Roadblock

Parts.Description: A tough armoured van with a ram on the roof and a roof light bar.
Parts.Name: SWAT Van

Parts.Description: A huge WANTED poster on two posts. Somebody is up to no good.
Parts.Name: Wanted Board

Parts.Description: A fenced yard with a yellow tow truck, wrecked cars and a pile of old tyres.
Parts.Name: Impound Yard

Parts.Description: A covered stand with three police motorbikes ready to roll.
Parts.Name: Bike Patrol

Parts.Description: A giant golden police badge on a tall navy pedestal, with four lamps around the plaza.
Parts.Name: Golden Badge Monument
